cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: A Necessary Heartbreak
cards.instruction: Describe disappointment, rejection, or loss as the exact experience everyone needed in order to grow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. That rejection was exactly the lesson our bakery needed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. And now we've learned not to need one contract.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can't pay the mixer loan.

beats.text: A powerful second lesson about attachment to equipment.

mechanism: A grades its bakery pupil dependence on success as something rejection necessarily cures, extending the lesson to threatened equipment.
confusable: Not claiming A engineered the rejection: A opportunistically treats each genuine loss as required education.
comparison: Business loss reinterpreted versus reciprocal sentimental loss.
